## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:devx#2` · head `4ca7c249885c23e8f1e9a58793fd31239dd71db9` · 2026-11-01T17:06Z

Checked against GitHub and the PR head, not against the report (os-dev-report 6561014899 on #28701).

- **Shape:** a draft to `main` with `Fixes #28701` once, `Part of #27377`, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. It has no assignees and no reviewers. `skip-changeset` is correct, because the PR changes only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` and publishes no package.
- **Path surface:** exactly the five area files the card names (+82/−39), 10 items. `check-governed-merges --pr 28748` reports it NOT governed and under the 3000-line threshold. It touches no contract face, so the seat reads it with CI and no second agent.
- **Card rules, read in the diff:** all 18 rows are edited and none is reported as fixed upstream. The seat read every changed field against main, item by item:
  - Row 2 changes only the factual half of the formula-field knownGap (#27482 open; #27612, #27643 and #27644 landed; the residual first autosave, pinned by `PermissionMatrixEditor.serverVerdictHold-27482.test.tsx`). acceptance[4]'s "no PUT issued" is untouched and still scored fail, as the card requires.
  - Rows 1, 7 and 10 drop "FAILS TODAY" knownGaps only where a merged fix and a pinned test back the drop (`celAuthoring.test.ts`, PR #27784, PR #27720). Row 5 drops D10 on the `refusalClearsOnRevert-26846` pin and keeps D13.
  - Rows 8 and 17 make clauses stricter: dashboard acceptance[4].verify now judges three cases, and a reload with no prompt that loses an edit is a FAIL. formula-stdlib acceptance[5] now asks for the refusal at both promotion doors.
  - Row 18 retires the carried line by recording the live stage-2 read in approvals knownGaps[0]. The line itself is comment 6539452860 on #27377, already closed by anchor comment 6557904764.
  No clause is weakened. Each edited item takes revision +1 and one history row citing #28656 and #28701. Main's history stays an exact prefix in all 10 items.
- **Gates:** 16 derived families exit 0, and `--ran` reports 16/16. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is OK (16 areas, 352 items). The seat lands once every check on this head is green.
- **Accepted deviations:** some parts keep W3-RT's live reading without a source confirmation: row 18 as a whole, the egress-proxy half of row 11, the system-fields-first half of row 4, the 400 and 403 statuses in row 14, and the HTTP 422 in row 17 (pinned one layer down at `publishMetaItem`). Each one says so in its history row. Row 14 attributes the 403 to W3-RT's own flow and does not claim every autolaunched flow is refused, which matches `flow-start-admission.ts`.
- **Out of scope:** four other studio-authoring items still quote the `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG exec vitest run` form that the ui vitest guard refuses (`object-designer-roundtrip`, `record-page-roundtrip` and `permission-matrix-editor-ux` knownGaps[0], `packaged-automation-studio-lock` knownGaps[1]). They are in no card row, so they get their own card. The dev's report also named two records-forms items, but the seat read both and they already use the `cwd ui/` form, so they need nothing. `FOLLOW-UPS.md` line 778 still cites `expression-editors` knownGaps[4], which is now [3]. That file is append-only, so the history row of this item records the renumbering. `Skills-docs: none — checklist text only`.
- **Landing:** non-governed. Once every check on this head is green, the seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge.
